agent_notes: Reviewed the POST/PUT route split in src/roonseek/web/library.py and the helper extraction in src/roonseek/web/_filter_overrides.py. Both new routes (post_artist_filter_overrides, put_artist_filter_overrides) retain dependencies=[Depends(require_auth)]. OriginCheckMiddleware (src/roonseek/web/auth.py) gates by HTTP method globally across all routes, so splitting the combined POST+PUT handler into two separate route functions does not bypass CSRF/origin protection. The SQL update still uses parameterized placeholders (UPDATE artists SET filter_overrides = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?). The JSON body path (_overrides_from_json_body) still routes through merge_overrides, which enforces the ALLOWED_OVERRIDE_KEYS allowlist, preventing mass assignment. The form path (_overrides_from_form) only reads a fixed set of allowlisted field names before validation, so unknown form keys cannot reach the payload. No secrets, no sensitive logging (artist_id only, per T-7-17 comment, consistent with actual code), no new injection/XSS surface. This is a behavior-preserving refactor.

Splitting the old combined POST/PUT handler into post_artist_filter_overrides and put_artist_filter_overrides, with shared helpers (_overrides_from_form, _overrides_from_json_body, _validate_filter_overrides_payload, _apply_filter_overrides_update), is a clean separation of transport parsing from persistence. Behavior looks the same: _clear and the empty/null body still clear overrides, merge_overrides still validates the allowlist, and the 400 envelope code stays 'filter_overrides.invalid'.

The 'filter_overrides.invalid' HTTPException envelope is still built inline at four places in library.py. _validate_filter_overrides_payload consolidates one of them, and since all of them are in the same file this isn't a cross-module duplication concern.
No import cycles introduced. The new FormData import from starlette.datastructures sits next to the existing State import from the same module, so it adds no new third-party dependency.
